title: Native Pixie/Direct2D loading splash before WebView2 startup

decisions.text: Use Pixie's framework-agnostic D2D core only: Pixie.Canvas, Pixie.Canvas.D2D, Pixie.DrawingCanvas, Pixie.D2DHeaders, Pixie.Types, Pixie.WebColor, Pixie.Borders, Pixie.GradientLayer, Pixie.FontDescription (+ transitive units found in the spike). Exclude all *.VCL.*, *.FMX.*, *.Cairo.*, *ControlBase*, and HTML/SVG/Markdown units unless needed.

Splash is a native Win32 frameless top-level window drawn with Pixie D2D (ID2D1DCRenderTarget.BindDC on the window DC), created and shown BEFORE webview_create so it appears instantly, decoupled from WebView2 init.

Vendoring follows the repo convention (uos in SoundCore): Pixie lives in a git-ignored shared vendors\pixie fetched by a provision script in the AppCore repo; NO third-party sources/binaries committed. Only source search paths are added to build/win_x64/fpc-x64.cfg.
Localization reuses the SplashLang cfg key (ru default / en); status labels mirror the current splash phases.
Process: plan + ledger; per-step atomic commits (step-id prefixed); NO push; approval gate (PS0.3) before vendoring/implementation; visual launch is a manual gate.

OPEN (PS0.3): (a) provisioning method — shared ..\vendors\pixie + script (default) vs git subtree; (b) retire the in-WebView HTML splash vs keep it as a fallback; (c) splash visuals — spinner + step checklist (mirrors today) vs minimal logo+status.

steps.title: Plan & ledger
steps.verify: ledger JSON parses; dependsOn DAG acyclic; plan + ledger written
evidence: Pixie identified as the FPC/Delphi HTML/graphics engine at EchoScript/EchoRecorder/vendors/pixie (NOT the Nim library).

Static feasibility: Pixie.Canvas.D2D.pas uses only Windows, ActiveX, SysUtils, Classes, Math, Generics.Collections + Pixie.* (no LCL/VCL/FMX/Graphics). Base Pixie.Canvas.pas uses only Classes, Generics.Collections. TPixieD2DCanvas renders to an HDC via ID2D1DCRenderTarget.BindDC (and offscreen via CreateWicBitmapRenderTarget). => usable from plain FPC + WinAPI, no Lazarus.

steps.title: Feasibility spike: compile minimal Pixie D2D under plain FPC + render to a frameless window
steps.verify: the minimal Pixie D2D unit set compiles with AppCore's FPC toolchain (no LCL on the search path); a frameless test window shows Pixie-drawn text via BindDC; the window appears effectively instantly (<< WebView2 init).
evidence: CONFIRMED. Wrote scratchpad/pixiespike.pas (plain FPC, {$mode delphi}): a WS_POPUP frameless window; TPixieD2DCanvas.Create; on WM_PAINT -> canvas.SetViewSize + canvas.BeginPaint(HDC from Windows.BeginPaint) + TPixieDrawingCanvas.Bind + Brush/FillRect + Font/TextOut ('Loading...') + EndPaint. NO LCL/VCL/FMX units used.

Compiled with the vendored FPC (KKMindWave/VendorsCore/fpc) -Twin64 -Px86_64 -Mdelphi; 4820 lines, exe produced. Pixie units built: WebColor, Types, Utils, Canvas, Borders, GradientLayer, FontDescription, Encoding, WebP*, Canvas.D2D, D2DHeaders, SvgRenderer*, Html, Matrix, SimpleXml, Utf8, DataUri, ImageUtils, DrawingCanvas.

Ran pixiespike.exe: exit code 0, stdout 'spike: window loop exited cleanly' (self-closes via a 2.5s timer). So D2D factory + ID2D1DCRenderTarget.BindDC + BeginDraw/DirectWrite text/EndDraw all execute from plain FPC without error.

Required FPC package search paths (for PS1.1): rtl, rtl-objpas, rtl-generics, rtl-unicode, winunits-base, rtl-extra, fcl-base, fcl-image, paszlib, hash, pasjpeg. Pixie paths: source/common, source/paintbox. (Pixie.Canvas references FPImage + image decoders unconditionally, hence fcl-image/paszlib/hash/pasjpeg — all standard, already in the toolchain.)

steps.title: Approval gate (PS-D6)
steps.verify: owner confirms PS-D6 (a) provisioning method, (b) retire-vs-keep HTML splash, (c) splash visuals. PAUSE before PS1.1.
evidence: Owner locked PS-D6: (a) reuse the existing EchoScript/EchoRecorder/vendors/pixie copy (reference it from fpc-x64.cfg); (c) splash visuals = spinner + step checklist (mirrors the current HTML splash).
(b) retire-vs-keep HTML splash: not explicitly decided; DEFAULT = native splash replaces the HTML splash pre-ready, keep a minimal fallback if native/D2D init fails. Revisit at PS3.2.

steps.title: Add Pixie + package source paths to fpc-x64.cfg (reference EchoScript copy per PS-D6)
steps.verify: fpc-x64.cfg references the EchoScript Pixie source paths (source/common + source/paintbox) and the required FPC package unit dirs; no third-party sources copied/committed.
evidence: Owner overrode PS-D3 at PS0.3: no vendors\pixie copy / provision script; reference the existing EchoScript/EchoRecorder/vendors/pixie copy directly from fpc-x64.cfg. Provision-script + .gitignore artifacts dropped.
Added -Fu paths: fcl-image, paszlib, hash, pasjpeg (FPC packages) + ..\..\..\..\EchoScript\EchoRecorder\vendors\pixie\source\{common,paintbox}. All dirs verified present.

Cyrillic note: Pixie DrawText does WText := UnicodeString(Text) honoring the string's codepage; passing AppMain's UnicodeString phase text round-trips via the system ANSI codepage (1251 on target) => Cyrillic renders. No special encoding needed.

steps.title: AppMain still builds with Pixie on the search path
steps.verify: build_app.bat succeeds with the Pixie paths added; no regression in the current app.
evidence: build_app.bat: 'Build successful: build\win_x64\bin\AppMain.exe'. Adding the Pixie/package search paths did not disturb the existing AppMain build (Pixie units not yet referenced by any unit).

steps.title: AppSplash.pas — frameless top-level splash window
steps.verify: a borderless rectangular window is created, shown centered, and destroyed cleanly; no taskbar button; created in << WebView2 init time.
evidence: AppSplash.pas: WS_POPUP + WS_EX_TOPMOST|TOOLWINDOW|NOACTIVATE frameless banner (no taskbar button, no focus steal), created on its own thread via BeginThread, centered on the cursor's monitor. startSplash waits (bounded 3s) on a 'ready' event so the banner is up before the caller proceeds to webview_create.
Verified by a scratchpad smoke test (splashtest.pas) driven through phases: window shows + closes cleanly, process exit 0 (when a console is attached).

steps.title: Pixie D2D rendering + splashSetPhase API (localized)
steps.verify: background, app title, and a step line/checklist are drawn with Pixie via BindDC; splashSetPhase(text) updates the drawn status; ru/en per SplashLang.
evidence: paintSplash draws via TPixieDrawingCanvas over BindDC: dark background + hairline border, spinner, bold title, and a checklist. Step markers are drawn geometrically (green check for done, cyan dot for active) instead of Unicode glyphs, so they do not depend on the system codepage.
API: splashSetTitle(text), splashSetPhase(text) (marks the current step done, appends the new active step). Localization stays in AppMain.tr(ru,en) per SplashLang and is passed in as text.

Screenshot confirmed correct rendering incl. Cyrillic ('Запуск…', 'Запуск сервера' done + green check, 'Запуск интерфейса' active + cyan dot) — Cyrillic round-trips via the system ANSI codepage as predicted.

steps.title: Animation + thread-safe status updates
steps.verify: WM_TIMER-driven spinner animates; status set from the startup worker thread is rendered without races or flicker.
evidence: WM_TIMER (~30fps) advances gTick and invalidates; a rotating cyan arc over a static grey ring. WM_ERASEBKGND returns 1 (all painting in WM_PAINT) to avoid flicker.

Cross-thread status: splashSetTitle/splashSetPhase mutate shared state under a critical section; paintSplash snapshots it under the same lock, then draws without holding it. The splash owns/creates/frees the Pixie D2D objects on its own thread only (D2D is thread-affine).

Threading correctness: switched the splash + startup threads from raw CreateThread to FPC BeginThread so the RTL installs thread-local state/exception frames for the Pixie + string work (raw CreateThread caused RTE 217). stopSplash waits on a 'done' event set after full COM teardown, so it never returns mid-release.

steps.title: Per-monitor DPI for the splash
steps.verify: splash size/text scale by the target monitor DPI (PMv2); centered correctly on high-DPI / multi-monitor.
evidence: Drawing uses logical (96-dpi) coordinates; gScale = GetDpiForWindow(splash)/96 (loaded dynamically, fallback 1.0) is applied via TPixieD2DCanvas.SetScale, and the BindDC rect uses the physical size (SetViewSize(physW,physH)). The window is sized physW×physH and re-centered on the target monitor.

Target monitor = the one under the cursor (MonitorFromPoint + GetMonitorInfoW, declared locally as they are absent from this FPC's Windows unit), so the banner appears where the user launched; falls back to the primary monitor.

steps.title: Reorder startup: native splash first, WebView2 in background, swap on ready
steps.verify: splash shows before webview_create; startServices + WebView2 run in the worker; status pushed to the splash; on port-ready the WebView2 window is shown and the splash destroyed; no blank-window gap.
evidence: AppMain now: startSplash(tr('Загрузка…','Loading')) BEFORE webview_create; the WebView2 window is kept hidden (ShowWindow SW_HIDE) while the splash (topmost) covers the gap.

startupThread (BeginThread): startServices pushes phases via splashSetPhase; on ready webview_dispatch(revealWhenReady) shows the window (behind the still-topmost splash), builds the control bar in full-screen mode, and navigates to the app URL; the worker then Sleeps SPLASH_LINGER_MS (700ms) so WebView2 paints the loaded page, then stopSplash() removes the banner — no blank-white swap.
AppMain builds cleanly (build_app.bat) with the new flow.

steps.title: Retire (or flag) the in-WebView HTML splash
steps.verify: the HTML splash is removed or gated; only the native splash is shown pre-ready.
evidence: Removed SPLASH_HTML and the whole HTML-splash plumbing (webview_set_html splash, pushEval/doEval, splashPhase/splashTitle JS wrappers). The native Pixie splash is now the only pre-ready UI.
PS-D6(b) resolved: HTML splash fully retired (not kept as fallback). The remaining fallback is the class's dark background brush if D2D init fails, so the banner is still a dark rectangle.

steps.title: Build, deploy, visual gate
steps.verify: AppMain builds; deployed to SoundTrainer + MindWaveCore; owner confirms visually: instant splash, advancing status, clean swap to the UI.
evidence: AppMain built cleanly (build_app.bat). Deployed AppMain.exe + libwebview.dll (3,413,891 bytes, matching) to all three consumers: KKLeftRight/server (auto by build), SoundTrainer/server, MindWaveCore/server.

Splash rendering verified out-of-band via a scratchpad smoke test + screenshot (spinner, title, checklist, Cyrillic correct). The end-to-end in-app visual gate (instant splash -> advancing status -> clean swap) is the owner's manual launch check.

steps.title: STATUS/docs update + final commit
steps.verify: ledger marked complete; docs reflect the native splash; final commit made.
evidence: AGENTS.md: added a 'Startup splash (native Pixie/Direct2D)' section and documented the Pixie build dependency (referenced from EchoScript; +fcl-image/paszlib/hash/pasjpeg).
Ledger: all steps PS0.1..PS4.2 done. Only the owner's in-app visual confirmation remains (manual gate, PS4.1).

steps.title: Profile startup: find why the splash appears slowly
steps.verify: high-res timing of each startup phase captured to a log; the dominant cost identified.
evidence: Added AppProfile.pas (QueryPerformanceCounter marks, thread-safe, zero-cost when disabled) + marks across AppMain and the splash thread. Flags: --profile-splash (log time-to-splash and exit), --profile (log at run-loop entry). Log: %TEMP%\appcore-startup-profile.log.

Finding (5 runs, Mode=dev): time-to-splash ~4210ms, of which resolveFreePorts = ~4080ms. All else tiny: pre-main (DLL load+RTL) ~17ms, dpi/args/config/autoupdate <1ms, splash thread ~110ms (D2D/DirectWrite factory ~75ms + window ~12ms + first paint ~23ms).

Root cause: findFreePort -> portInUse did a BLOCKING connect() to 127.0.0.1:4300 and :9000; on this machine a free loopback port is not refused instantly (a security/firewall filter delays the RST ~2s), so two probes cost ~4s -- and they ran before the splash.

steps.title: Fix: non-blocking port probe + resolve ports behind the splash
steps.verify: splash appears in well under a second; port resolution no longer stalls the splash.
evidence: portInUse rewritten as a non-blocking connect + select with a 150ms timeout: a live loopback listener still accepts in ~1ms (fast in-use detection); a free port that is not refused instantly times out at 150ms and is treated as free -- no multi-second stall.
resolveFreePorts moved to AFTER startSplash (behind the visible banner); applyExeAutoUpdate stays before the splash so a self-update relaunch never flashes two splashes.

Re-profiled (4 runs): time-to-splash ~100-145ms (from process start ~120-160ms), a ~30x improvement. Remaining cost is the unavoidable Direct2D/DirectWrite factory init (~70-100ms). Redeployed to KKLeftRight/SoundTrainer/MindWaveCore.

steps.title: Fix empty-window flash: keep the main window hidden until reveal
steps.verify: the WebView2 window never appears empty during startup; it is shown once, at the correct place/size/state.
evidence: Root cause: the WebView2 window (created hidden by the library) was revealed early by our own setup -- fullscreen used SetWindowLong(GWL_STYLE, WS_POPUP or WS_VISIBLE) which + SetWindowPos(SWP_FRAMECHANGED) realised the window; windowed used webview_set_size (calls window_show -> ShowWindow) and attachWindowState/SetWindowPlacement (SW_SHOWNORMAL/MAXIMIZED). All showed an empty window before content/reveal.

Fix: configure the window while hidden. Fullscreen: WS_POPUP only (no WS_VISIBLE); size via SetWindowPos without show. Windowed: size via our own SetWindowPos (not webview_set_size), and restoreWindowState now positions with SW_HIDE and records the intended show state (restoredShowCmd). New showMainWindow() reveals it once (ShowWindow SW_SHOW + control bar for fullscreen; SW_SHOWNORMAL/MAXIMIZED for windowed) from revealWhenReady / the no-services path.

Verified deterministically: polled the 'webview'-class window's IsWindowVisible every 60ms after launch -> hidden until ~1090ms, then VISIBLE exactly once at ~1174ms (reveal), staying visible. No hidden->visible->hidden toggle => no flash.

steps.title: Really eliminate the empty-window flash (webview auto-show + reveal placement)
steps.verify: during startup only the splash is on-screen; the webview appears once, directly at its final monitor/geometry; no control-bar flicker.
evidence: Diagnosed with a per-window IsWindowVisible+rect poll: the real cause was the webview library itself -- engine_base dispatch_size_default queues a default set_size (-> window_show) that runs on the first webview_run iteration; set_size uses SWP_NOMOVE, so it resized to ~653x493 AT our (0,0) position and showed the window -> empty white window at top-left for ~3s.

Fix 1 (AppMain): right after webview_create, park the window far off-screen and call webview_set_size(800,600) there -- this claims the size slot (m_is_size_set) so the queued default is skipped, and the one auto-show happens off-screen; then ShowWindow(SW_HIDE). Now only showMainWindow ever reveals it.

Fix 2 (reveal placement): createControlBar now applies applyMainGeometry synchronously so the hidden window is positioned on the saved kiosk monitor BEFORE showMainWindow shows it (no transient on the primary monitor); the control bar starts hidden and is shown already-positioned by the first updateBar (no (0,0) flicker).

Verified (MindWaveCore, fullscreen kiosk on monitor 2): during load only the splash is on-screen; webview first appears at 1928x1148 @(3070,5) and the bar at 176x30 @(3946,5) -- both directly on monitor 2, no early/primary flash.
